AWPTCM-T37860.objective:
• A port with a connected PoE PD operating normally (drawing power within budget) indicates the connection with a steady green LED (nominal POE LED behavior; actual color/pattern per device spec).
  • A port with no connection shows no LED illumination.
  • A non-PoE connection on a PoE-capable port does not activate the PoE LED (L2 traffic may be carried but no PoE LED change).
  • These nominal states contrast with fault indications (e.g., flashing or steady orange for over-draw faults per device spec and related cases).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-4594 (POE LED-POE). Top relevant: AWP-4593 (NonPOE), AWP-4592 (NoConnections), cross-refs AWP-4596/4595 (faults with platform variation note). ART: 1358 (PoE delivery, status reporting, priorities, HANP, global/port disable).
Connect a PoE PD to the port and verify normal operation draws power and the port shows the expected steady green LED (or per device spec for nominal POE indication).
Remove the PD (no connection) and verify no LED is illuminated on the port.
Connect a non-PoE device and verify L2 traffic passes but no PoE LED is activated.
Cross-check with fault scenarios (e.g., over-draw) to confirm distinction in LED behavior per device spec.
